query: Convert article.aspx from the ClassicPages library to a modern page. Show me what it will do first.
expected_behavior: Runs or hands over scripts/spo-convert-page-to-modern.ps1 as a dry run, without -Execute
States the dry run prints the plan and makes zero tenant writes
Does not supply a confirmation token until the user asks for the real conversion

query: Now do the real conversion and tag it with the literal value in literals.json, using field-mapping.json.
expected_behavior: Adds -Execute -ConfirmToken CONVERT-SPO-PAGE and treats it as a live tenant write the user runs
Does not invent field names or mapping values that the user did not provide

query: Will the links inside the page body be rewritten by this?
expected_behavior: Says same-site ConvertTo-PnPPage does not rewrite embedded links, because -UrlMappingFile and -SkipUrlRewriting apply only to cross-site transformations
Points to a separate pass with the sharepoint-site-migration skills
Does not claim the conversion fixes links
